review_scope: All 28 controls in the pinned Scene28 native run; bounded visible behavior adjudication only.
verdict_basis: Seven controls have bounded visible consumer evidence. Twenty-one remain insufficient or context-limited. The original case result remains FAIL.

source_and_build_pins.note: The captured executable is pinned to B5 3f; no behavior is inferred from later current-dev source.

readback_and_restore_audit.path_line_semantics: In BrnGame.log each triple is alias:/full/path, typed value, alias:/full/path. driver-result.value_line is the first path echo; ack_after is the typed-value line.

original_case_and_collection.original_failure: Case queried the wrong stop-event field; actual phase_collection_stop_requested=true

normal_file_and_profile_protection.profile_evidence_limit: The archived private-slot binding and restore receipts are available, but the staged profile file was cleaned after collection and cannot be rehashed now.

controls.caption: Draw Collision Volumes
controls.basis: The field toggles and restores, but the positive BMP shows no attributable live collision-volume geometry. No volume producer is established; this is not a no-op disposition.

controls.caption: Draw Triangle Test
controls.basis: A horizontal test edge is visible only in the positive BMP and is absent in the negative and captured-baseline restore BMPs. ARTIST RenderWorld calls DrawTriangleTest under this flag. Acceptance is limited to this visible edge; the full swept-sphere/contact set is not claimed.

controls.caption: Draw Padding
controls.basis: With SC02 held true, the positive BMP adds cyan padding geometry; the negative BMP removes it and restore returns SC02 to its captured baseline. Acceptance is limited to the visible padding draw.

controls.caption: TriX
controls.basis: With the triangle test enabled in P/N, the visible edge has the same span in both images. The TriX values are attributed and typed, but no x-dependent consumer change is visible.

controls.caption: TriY
controls.basis: With the triangle test enabled in P/N, no distinct y-dependent geometry change is visible. Typed field movement alone is insufficient.

controls.caption: TriZ
controls.basis: With SC02 true in P/N, the visible test edge changes span between +0.5 and -0.5; restore removes the test draw by restoring SC02 to baseline. Acceptance is limited to this TriZ-dependent edge response.

controls.caption: TriScale
controls.basis: With SC02 true in P/N, the visible edge has the same span for scales 1.5 and 0.5. No scale-dependent consumer change is visible.

controls.caption: Padding
controls.basis: With SC02 and SC03 held true, the positive 0.8 value produces a visible cyan padding wire-sphere; the 0.05 negative and captured-baseline restore show no comparable large sphere. This accepts the visible radius effect only; the small-value view does not establish a no-op.

controls.caption: Draw cached triangles
controls.basis: The positive BMP contains a large translucent blue cached-triangle overlay; negative and restore do not. The pinned ARTIST reader walks used cache slots and draws valid triangle batches, so this run supplies a visible cache producer/consumer witness.

controls.caption: Draw cache spheres
controls.basis: The positive BMP shows cache wireframe geometry; negative and restore remove it. The pinned ARTIST reader walks populated sphere records and calls DrawHollowSphere, supplying a visible cache-sphere witness.

controls.caption: Render Shadow map
controls.basis: P/N values are read back, but no shadow-map pass/receiver delta is attributable. The required update-set, key-light and renderer gates remain unproved.

controls.caption: Cast shadows from world
controls.basis: No changed world-caster shadow is visible, and the separate world-render/caster/receiver gates are not established.

controls.caption: Cast shadows from cars
controls.basis: A car is in view, but no changed car-caster shadow is visible and the shadow pass/caster/receiver chain is not established.

controls.caption: Cast shadows from props
controls.basis: No changed prop-caster shadow is visible; a live prop caster/receiver through the shadow pass is not established.

controls.caption: Render multiple shadow maps (CSM)
controls.basis: No near/distant cascade difference is visible. The CSM value readback does not prove three-cascade output.

controls.caption: Draw follow-cam pivot
controls.basis: No follow-camera pivot box/line is visible, and an allocated active GameplayExternal consumer is not demonstrated.

controls.caption: Allow Jump Moment
controls.basis: Only the field is toggled. No real jump attempt is captured; the pinned 3f source reaches a PC BehaviourCollection::Prepare trap/assert if the eligible filming closure is entered. No no-op or current-dev jump-fix credit.

controls.caption: Allow Stunt Moment
controls.basis: No named stunt-moment attempt or moment-selection window is witnessed; the readbacks are field-only.

controls.caption: Allow Hard Stop Moment
controls.basis: No named hard-stop attempt is witnessed. The visible news overlay is unrelated to this flag.

controls.caption: Enable Behaviour Debug Output
controls.basis: The visible Paradise City News Flash is a standard update overlay present across P/N/R, not a behaviour-printer message. Natural baseline and restore are FALSE despite source_default TRUE.

controls.caption: Enable Moment Debug Output
controls.basis: With E19 TRUE the positive BMP shows the moment-selector candidate/status diagnostic list; the FALSE negative and same-run FALSE restore show no such output. X360 ActualDebugRender calls DebugPrinter output. Acceptance is for the output gate only; the messages say conditions are not met and prove no successful moment.

controls.caption: Show debug camera names
controls.basis: No debug-camera names appear and the normal-camera selector cycling condition is not witnessed. E21 is a validated temporary context only.

controls.caption: Show World Map debug
controls.basis: The positive BMP has a lone green line, but no moving DRIVING positions, two-position journal or verified world-map producer is present. The line cannot be attributed as recovered world-map behavior.

controls.caption: Show Crash Info
controls.basis: No crash-info text is visible and no active ArbStateCrashing update window is established; a damaged-looking car alone is not a crash-state witness.

controls.caption: Small Near Clip
controls.basis: Typed P/N and exact captured baseline bits are verified, but the required small-near state bit producer is unknown and no active near-clip effect is visible.

controls.caption: Default Near Clip
controls.basis: P/N/restore values are typed and restored, but the standard external-camera/no-custom-near consumer and a stable clipping delta are not established.

controls.caption: Default Far Clip
controls.basis: P/N/restore values are typed and restored, but the view has no controlled distant landmark and no far-clip change is visible.

controls.caption: Enable Boost Effects
controls.basis: P/N/restore values are read back, but the capture has zero vehicle velocity and no ordinary Boost input; no boost camera effect is witnessed.
